Implemented in `output/main.js` and `output/bibtex.js`.

- `output/main.js` now accepts `--bib`, `--style`, `--cites`, `--aux`, `--output`, and `--log`, handles argument errors, and writes the required error JSON.
- `output/bibtex.js` now provides the BibTeX-style parser/interpreter, crossref handling, name formatting, line wrapping, special-character handling, and structured warning/log output.
- The module exports `runBibtexTool` and supporting helpers so the CLI wrapper can invoke it cleanly.

Verified with end-to-end smoke tests against the authoritative `plain.bst`, `abbrv.bst`, `unsrt.bst`, and `alpha.bst` files using a sample `.bib`.
